h: Why the haftarah of Adoniyahu belongs to this parashah

p: The connection of the matter of Adoniyahu
הוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
is according to what is written in the holy Zohar
“a hundred, which is a great number,
has ‘year’ (in the singular) written with it,” etc.
that one should not grow proud
of the matters of this world
and least of all among the Patriarchs,
that he did not choose greatness
that he answered what they said to him,
“Let the world not lack its King,” etc.
Rather, the main thing that needed teaching
is that one not grow proud, God forbid,
in levels of surpassing holiness and purity.

h: Sarah's years: refined in all ten attributes

p: And here, where it is written of Sarah
it shows that she was refined
and as stated in the holy Zohar
that seven corresponds to the seven attributes,
and a hundred to Keser Elyon,
the most hidden of all hidden;
and the number one hundred is a complete number,
So too of Avraham it is written,
“And Avraham was old, come into days”
that is, into the first three (sefiros).
And although earlier it is written,
“And Avraham and Sarah were old, coming into days,”
that they had been refined in all seven attributes,
which are the seven days of Creation,
and were coming to be refined
in the attributes of the first three.
This is because there was need
for the soul of Yitzchak to be born,
who was circumcised at eight days,
so the parents had to be
from the matters of this world.
That is why Yitzchak was born to Avraham
Therefore it is written “coming into days”:
they had already come to be refined

rich.text: Parallels:

(1) Pri Tzaddik, Pesach 42. Same Gemara and same move: the greatness meant is not this-worldly but "when Hashem bestows light"; from the revealed light "one can come to pride, God forbid, and then they would lose everything". (2) Pri Tzaddik, Vayikra 1: Avraham's worldly kingship "counted for nothing with him"; his "dust and ashes" came when his prayer prevailed, and Moshe's "what are we" is the higher level. (3) Pri Tzaddik, Parshas Shekalim 7: after "dust and ashes" Avraham reached Atika, and after the tenth trial "ten times ten… ביומין עלאין". This joins the two halves of this maamar.
